calendar.matters:
ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar May-31-2007 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for OSC hearing for Change of Name of a Minor.
Dept. 218, Commissioner: Sue Kaplan, Clerk: Gina Gonzales, CSR: Patricia Van Steenberge.
Petitioner: Yaofeng Liu, present in pro per as Guardian ad litem for the Minor: Rui Kang Liu with Interpreter: Charles Zheng, were sworn and examined.
The minor's mother also signed the petition.
No objections to the proposed change of name were made at the hearing.
It appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations in the petition are true, correct, and sufficient and that the petition should be granted.
The Court grants the petition for Change of Name of a Minor to: Andy Liu.
Decree signed in open court.
